oncall-bot: @Maria G — auto-page: High p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate (streaming) in us-west-2. SLO breach (p99 > 1200ms). Incident created: INC-2250-091. Please acknowledge and triage.

Maria G: acknowledging, jumping on it now.

Alex W: seeing the alert too, 10% of streaming requests are stalling at server-side assembly. p95 up to ~320ms, p99 jumping to ~1800ms for a 12m window.

Jordan (SRE): marking impact: partial — some customers on dedicated pools in us-west-2 experiencing degraded tails. Not global.

Maria G: capturing initial data: routing table shows ~4% requests routed to gpu-pool-b. Health for node gpu-node-5 shows rising ECC correctable errors in nvidia-smi and thermal trip logs.

Lee: echoing, telemetry from prometheus: kernel_throttle_count on gpu-node-5 spiked at 14:02 UTC. GPU temperature rose to 93C repeatedly.

Maria G: posting relevant logs snippet:
```
[2025-06-12T14:02:13Z] nvidia: Correctable ECC errors on GPU 5: 42 per min
[2025-06-12T14:02:15Z] nvidia: GPU 5 thermal throttling engaged, perf level reduced
[2025-06-12T14:02:16Z] runtime: streaming stall detected, waiting for device response
```

Jordan (SRE): looks like hardware-level thermal throttling + ECC flakiness causing stalls and longer KV cache io. Could be intermittent GPU flake. Recommend immediate mitigation: take gpu-node-5 OOS/cordon, drain workloads, and scale up fallback pool.

Maria G: starting drain: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-5 && kubectl drain gpu-node-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

infra-ops: standing by for cordon/drain. I'll start moving long-running streaming pods off that node and trigger autoscale for dedicated fallback pool.

incidents-bot: Severity escalated to Sev1 due to customer impact on premium accounts. Notify CSMs.

CSM Sam: notified. Which customers are in the path so I can send a short explainer?

Alex W: affected prefixes show two customers with high API rate in that pool: Scaleify and DocuDraft (both on dedicated-d2). Scaleify saw 15% error increases, DocuDraft had increased timeouts.

Maria G: immediate mitigation checklist:
- cordon/drain gpu-node-5 (in progress)
- route new streaming sessions away from gpu-pool-b to gpu-pool-a and cpu-fallback pool
- temporarily disable batching on streaming route to reduce head-of-line stalls
- enable model-fallback small variant (quantized) for best-effort traffic
- contact infra for hardware inspection / hot-swap

Lee: implemented routing change: `PATCH /routing/pools/gpu-pool-b` with body `{
  "prefer": ["gpu-pool-a","cpu-fallback"],
  "weight_override": {"gpu-pool-b":0.0}
}`

Alex W: confirmed new sessions are landing elsewhere. p99 trending down after 2 mins — now ~900ms and dropping. Streaming stall counts reduced by ~70%.

Maria G: drain finished at 14:06 UTC. Node is unschedulable and pods evicted.

Jordan (SRE): while drains remove pressure, we should patch autoscaler to bring additional dedicated capacity and monitor tail latency. Also enabling extra logging on streaming assembler for traces.

Maria G: enabling debug traces: `REDWOOD_DEBUG_STREAM=true` in route for 30m. Will collect traces to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/2250012345/traces.tar.gz

infra-ops: confirmed GPU 5 shows sustained thermal events and increasing correctable ECCs on the card. Suggest replacing the card and running burn-in. Will start hardware ticket and arrange hot-swap.

CSM Sam: I'll draft a customer note: short, non-technical, apologetic, noting mitigation steps and that we're monitoring. Will sync with ops before sending.

incidents-bot: page rotation: @Jordan (SRE) is lead for remediation. @Maria G is coordinating mitigations. Postmortem owner required.

Jordan (SRE): assigning postmortem owner to Alex W for now. Alex will coordinate follow-up with infra and hardware replacement timeline.

Alex W: will own postmortem. Immediate action items logged to INC-2250-091:
- A1: Replace GPU on gpu-node-5 and run 2-hour burn-in (infra)
- A2: Validate ECC counters return to baseline (infra + infra-telemetry)
- A3: Add automated node isolation if ECC correctables exceed threshold for >2m (sre)
- A4: Update routing fallback to prefer CPU pool sooner when streaming stalls detected (runtime)
- A5: Customer communications (CSM Sam)

Maria G: p99 now ~320ms, p95 ~220ms. No new customer errors reported for the last 6 minutes. Keeping the incident open for monitoring and hardware replacement.

Lee: adding temporary alert rule change to reduce noise: raise ECC correctables alert from 20/min to 50/min for 10m to avoid thrash during burn-in. (we'll revert after).

infra-ops: hardware ticket created: HT-80921, ETA for technician swap 4 hours due to spare availability. Will attempt remote reset first.

Jordan (SRE): remote reset attempted (powercycle passthrough) — short-term improvement observed, but ECC counts resumed climbing after 18 mins. Proceeding with replacement.

CSM Sam: draft message ready, will send proactive note to Scaleify + DocuDraft once Alex gives final mitigations list.

Maria G: closing update for now: traffic stable, fallbacks applied, node isolated. Will transition to post-incident follow-up channel after 60m if no recurrence.

incidents-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident remains open.

Alex W: postmortem timeline: I'll prepare a 72-hour incident capture with telemetry, logs, and recommended changes. Tentative RCA meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC.

Jordan (SRE): adding one more to A3: add test to CI that simulates ECC spikes to ensure routing fallbacks act within 30s.

Maria G: thanks team. @CSM Sam please CC support@scaleify.com and support@docudraft.com when you send the note.

CSM Sam: will send within 20m after brief review. :white_check_mark:

Lee: leaving monitoring watch for next 90m. Ping me if any p99 > 600ms.

Alex W: outstanding: confirm hardware swap complete and confirm ECC counters stable for 2 hours -> then we can close.

Maria G: acknowledged.

incidents-bot: summary saved to incident folder s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2250-091/summary.txt

(oncall-bot): If you are the on-call responder, react with :thumbsup: to acknowledge this thread.

Alex W: :thumbsup:

Jordan (SRE): :thumbsup:

Maria G: :thumbsup:

CSM Sam: will post customer note and follow up.

infra-ops: will update HT-80921 as actions complete.

-- end of thread --
